selection.created: 2026-09-30, before the dev-test (2021) confirmation and before any v2 final run
selection.learner_rule: learner with the higher best validation AUPRC on the ALL feature set (standard 0.1816 vs residual_b2 0.1792)
selection.params_rule: highest validation-2020 AUPRC over the stage-1 grid (12 configs) + stage-2 refinement (8 configs), same grid for B2 and Sentinel; class weighting (scale_pos_weight 3, 9) tested and rejected
selection.groups_rule: keep group iff 3-seed mean validation AUPRC(B2+group) > 3-seed mean AUPRC(B2)
